svg.title: Autocomplete latency by query class
svg.desc: p1: sift 0.19, sift (positions off) 0.19, pg_search 0.54, pg_textsearch 525, rum 24.46, pgx-bm25 4.97, Elasticsearch 0.32; p2: ; p3: sift 0.19, sift (positions off) 0.19, pg_search 0.67, pg_textsearch 8.17, rum 2.55, pgx-bm25 21.78, Elasticsearch 0.34; p4: ; w1: sift 0.14, sift (positions off) 0.15, pg_search 0.77, pg_textsearch 2.80, rum 0.29, pgx-bm25 1.70, Elasticsearch 0.17; a2: sift 0.17, sift (positions off) 0.17, pg_search 0.90, pg_textsearch 2.78, rum 5.57, pgx-bm25 2.85, Elasticsearch 0.18; a2s: ; a3: sift 0.19, sift (positions off) 0.18, pg_search 1.38, pg_textsearch 2.82, rum 5.70, pgx-bm25 5.94, Elasticsearch 0.19; x2: sift 0.17, sift (positions off) 0.19, pg_search 1.06, pg_textsearch 2.82, rum 3.64, pgx-bm25 4.05, Elasticsearch 0.21
svg.text: p50 milliseconds, logarithmic axis, lower is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
NA: no bar, the engine cannot run the workload or was not run on the dataset.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP, edge n-grams of the typed words expanded by the client.
pg_textsearch: emulation (edge n-gram text, it has no native prefix scoring), see docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
p1-p4: 1-4 letter prefix; w1: whole word; a2, a2s: word + 2 or 1 letter prefix; a3, x2: 3 or 2 prefixes
GeoNames cities15000, 34,173 places, top-20, 1 client, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 4-6); Oct 2026.
